label: Bible Study
prompt: And to know the love of Christ, which _____ knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
verse: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
note: Paul prays to know a love too big to know — and he means it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For we have great _____ and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
verse: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
note: Paul tells Philemon his love has refreshed the hearts of the saints — and brought Paul great joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five _____.
verse: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
note: The pool of Bethesda had five porches, crowded with the sick waiting for the moving of the water.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The harvest is past, the _____ is ended, and we are not saved.
verse: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
note: Harvest came and went and no rescue arrived — the saddest end-of-season line in Scripture.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Blotting out the _____ of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
verse: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
note: 'The handwriting of ordinances' that stood against us — blotted out, taken away, and nailed to the cross.
